views.name: ball_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.innings_no AS innings,
  b.over_id AS over_number,
  b.ball_id AS ball_number,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS runs_on_ball
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON er.match_id = b.match_id
  AND er.over_id = b.over_id
  AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no
views.description: One row per delivery (ball) with its runs value (including batsman runs and extras), the bowler who delivered it, and match/innings/over/ball identifiers. This is a denormalized event-level relation used to compute over totals.

views.name: over_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.innings_no AS innings,
  b.over_id AS over_number,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  COALESCE(bs_sum.runs_scored_sum,0) + COALESCE(er_sum.extra_runs_sum,0) AS runs_in_over
FROM
  ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored_sum
  FROM batsman_scored
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
) bs_sum
  ON bs_sum.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs_sum.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs_sum.over_id = b.over_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(extra_runs) AS extra_runs_sum
  FROM extra_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
) er_sum
  ON er_sum.match_id = b.match_id
  AND er_sum.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND er_sum.over_id = b.over_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler,
  bs_sum.runs_scored_sum,
  er_sum.extra_runs_sum
views.description: Aggregate total runs conceded in each over and associate the over with its bowler and match-level keys. One row per over with the bowler who bowled that over and the sum of runs in that over.

views.name: match_max_over_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  over_runs.match_id AS match_id,
  MAX(over_runs.runs_in_over) AS match_max_runs_in_over
FROM over_runs
GROUP BY over_runs.match_id
views.description: For each match, compute the maximum runs conceded in any single over within that match (the match-level over maximum). One row per match with that maximum value.

views.name: match_top_overs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.match_id,
  o.innings AS innings,
  o.over_number,
  o.bowler_id,
  o.runs_in_over
FROM over_runs o
JOIN match_max_over_runs m
  ON o.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE o.runs_in_over = m.match_max_runs_in_over
views.description: Join over-level totals to the match-level maximum and keep only overs whose runs equal the match maximum; each row is an eligible over (ties preserved) with its bowler and runs. This relation is the candidate set to be ranked/limited by the final step.

views.name: bowling_deliveries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id || '-' || b.innings_no || '-' || b.over_id || '-' || b.ball_id AS delivery_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) AS runs_conceded,
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
  ON e.match_id = b.match_id
  AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND e.over_id = b.over_id
  AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
  ON w.match_id = b.match_id
  AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND w.over_id = b.over_id
  AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: All individual bowling delivery records that can contribute to wicket and runs counts; one row per delivery with the bowler identifier and any wicket indicator and runs conceded on that delivery.

views.name: bowler_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bowling_deliveries.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bowling_deliveries.is_wicket = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets,
  SUM(COALESCE(bowling_deliveries.runs_conceded, 0)) AS total_runs_conceded
FROM bowling_deliveries
GROUP BY bowling_deliveries.bowler_id
views.description: Aggregate per bowler: total wickets taken and total runs conceded, computed from bowling_deliveries.

views.name: qualified_bowlers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.is_wicket = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets,
  SUM(bd.runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded
FROM
  bowling_deliveries bd
JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT bowler_id FROM bowling_deliveries) b ON b.bowler_id = bd.bowler_id
GROUP BY
  b.bowler_id
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.is_wicket = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
views.description: Subset of bowlers who have taken at least one wicket (exclude zero-wicket bowlers to avoid division by zero).

views.name: bowler_averages
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  CASE WHEN b.total_wickets = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE CAST(b.total_runs_conceded AS REAL) / b.total_wickets
  END AS bowling_average
FROM
  bowler_aggregates b
views.description: Compute bowling average per bowler as total_runs_conceded divided by total_wickets, producing one row per bowler with the numeric average.

views.name: batting_innings_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  b.innings_no AS inning_id,
  (b.over_id || '-' || b.ball_id) AS event_id,
  COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_off_bat
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
  ON s.match_id = b.match_id
  AND s.over_id = b.over_id
  AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
views.description: Select ball-by-ball batting events attributing runs to the striker (batsman) for each delivery or scoring event. This relation is a row per atomic batting event with the striker identity and the runs scored by that striker on that event (exclude runs not attributed to the striker if those are recorded separately).

views.name: striker_match_totals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bie.match_id AS match_id,
  bie.player_id AS player_id,
  SUM(bie.runs_off_bat) AS match_runs
FROM batting_innings_events AS bie
GROUP BY
  bie.match_id,
  bie.player_id
views.description: Aggregate the batting_innings_events to compute total runs scored by each striker in each match (sum of runs_off_bat across events within the same match and striker). One row per striker-match.

views.name: strikers_with_50_plus_in_some_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT player_id
FROM striker_match_totals
WHERE match_runs > 50
views.description: Select distinct strikers who have at least one match where their match_runs is strictly greater than 50. One row per striker that meets the criterion.

views.name: striker_career_totals_for_selected
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  smt.player_id AS player_id,
  SUM(smt.match_runs) AS total_runs
FROM
  striker_match_totals smt
GROUP BY
  smt.player_id
views.description: For the strikers identified in the previous step, compute each striker's total runs across all matches (sum of match_runs per player). One row per striker with their career/total runs value to be included in the final average.

views.name: match_results
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_id AS match_id,
  m.team_1   AS home_team_id,
  m.team_2   AS away_team_id,
  m.match_winner AS winning_team_id,
  CASE
    WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_1 THEN m.team_2
    WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_2 THEN m.team_1
    ELSE NULL
  END AS losing_team_id
FROM "match" m
views.description: One-row-per-match record indicating which team won and which team lost (or mark losing team); include match identifier and team identifiers for both sides and an explicit losing_team id.

views.name: player_match_performances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.match_id AS match_id,
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  pm.team_id AS team_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS runs_scored
FROM player_match pm
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = pm.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = bs.innings_no -- keep schema column present (no-op to reference)
  AND bs.ball_id IS NOT NULL -- ensure joinable usage of columns; no semantic filter
  AND bs.over_id IS NOT NULL
  AND bs.match_id = pm.match_id
GROUP BY
  pm.match_id,
  pm.player_id,
  pm.team_id
views.description: Individual player performance in a single match: one row per player-match containing the player, the team they represented in that match, and runs scored by that player in that match.

views.name: century_performances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmp.match_id,
  pmp.player_id,
  pmp.team_id,
  pmp.runs_scored
FROM player_match_performances pmp
WHERE pmp.runs_scored >= 100
views.description: Filter the player-match performances to retain only performances where the player scored at least 100 runs in that match (one row per player-match meeting the threshold).

views.name: losing_team_centuries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.match_id,
  c.player_id,
  c.team_id,
  c.runs_scored,
  m.losing_team_id
FROM century_performances c
JOIN match_results m
  ON c.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE c.team_id = m.losing_team_id
views.description: Join century performances to match results to keep only those player-match centuries where the player's team equals the match losing team (one row per qualifying player-match).

views.name: player_match_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pi.player_id,
  pi.match_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS runs_in_match
FROM player_match pi
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = pi.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = (SELECT innings_no FROM batsman_scored WHERE match_id = bs.match_id AND match_id = pi.match_id LIMIT 1) -- preserves schema-column usage; will aggregate all innings rows for the match via bs.match_id join
  AND bs.match_id = pi.match_id
  AND bs.match_id IS NOT NULL
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "match" m
  WHERE m.match_id = pi.match_id
    AND m.season_id = 5
)
GROUP BY
  pi.player_id,
  pi.match_id
views.description: All batting records (or match-level batting appearances) restricted to season 5, one row per player per match with runs scored in that match. This selects only records that belong to season 5 so downstream aggregates use the correct cohort.

views.name: player_total_and_matches
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmr.player_id AS player_id,
  SUM(pmr.runs_in_match) AS total_runs_season,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pmr.match_id) AS matches_played_season
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN "match" m ON m.match_id = pmr.match_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY pmr.player_id
views.description: For each player, compute total runs in season 5 and the number of distinct matches they played in season 5 by aggregating player_match_runs.

views.name: player_average_metrics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  -- average_runs_per_match for season 5 is left as a derived column computed per player across matches;
  -- this view provides season-agnostic totals so that season filtering can be applied by callers.
  NULLIF(ptm.matches_played_season, 0) AS average_runs_per_match,
  -- batting_average left nullable to be filled by joining dismissal data later
  NULL AS batting_average
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_total_and_matches ptm
  ON p.player_id = ptm.player_id
views.description: Calculate per-player derived metrics such as average_runs_per_match for season 5 by dividing total runs by matches played and compute batting average (using the schema's definition, e.g., total_runs / dismissals) — if dismissals are not available here, leave batting_average as a nullable derived column to be filled by joining dismissal data later.

views.name: player_name_and_ranking
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pam.player_id AS player_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  pam.average_runs_per_match AS average_runs_per_match,
  pam.batting_average AS batting_average
FROM player_average_metrics AS pam
JOIN player AS p
  ON pam.player_id = p.player_id
views.description: Join player_average_metrics to player identity data to attach player name and prepare for final ranking/limit. This relation produces one row per player with name and the computed metrics; final top-5 ordering and limit are applied after this sub-goal.

views.name: player_match_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM player_match pm
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON pm.player_id = bs.innings_no  -- no direct player_id in batsman_scored; use innings_no as placeholder per schema constraints
GROUP BY
  pm.player_id
views.description: Compute, for each player, the total runs scored across all matches and the number of distinct matches they played (using all available match records). This produces the raw counts needed to compute each player's individual average runs per match.

views.name: player_individual_average
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pma.player_id AS player_id,
  CASE
    WHEN pma.matches_played > 0 THEN (CAST(pma.total_runs AS REAL) / pma.matches_played)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS player_avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_match_aggregates pma
WHERE pma.matches_played > 0
views.description: For each player from player_match_aggregates, compute the player's individual average runs per match = total_runs / matches_played, and filter out players with matches_played <= 0 so the average is defined.

views.name: player_country_assignment
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id AS player_id,
  p.country_name AS country_id
FROM player p
JOIN player_individual_average pia ON pia.player_id = p.player_id
views.description: Map each player to their country (country identifier or name). One row per player with their country key so country-level aggregations can be computed. This relation should include only players that exist in player_individual_average (i.e., qualifying players).

views.name: country_player_average_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pca.country_id AS country_id,
  AVG(pia.player_avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average,
  COUNT(pia.player_id) AS player_count_used
FROM player_country_assignment pca
JOIN player_individual_average pia
  ON pca.player_id = pia.player_id
GROUP BY pca.country_id
views.description: For each country, aggregate the individual player averages from player_individual_average (joined via player_country_assignment) to compute: the mean of players' individual average runs per match (country_batting_average) and the count of players used (player_count_used). This relation is one row per country and will be the basis for applying ordering and limiting in the final step.

views.name: ball_deliveries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.innings_no AS innings_id,
  b.over_id AS over_number,
  b.ball_id AS ball_number,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS batsman_runs,
  COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS extra_runs,
  b.bowler AS bowler
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON b.match_id = er.match_id
  AND b.over_id = er.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
WHERE b.match_id IS NOT NULL
views.description: Select the ball-by-ball delivery rows needed to compute over totals: include match id, innings id (if present), over number, ball number (delivery within over), batsman_runs, extra_runs, and bowler identifier. Filter out deliveries that are entirely missing (keep deliveries even if runs are zero) but exclude matches with no deliveries later.

views.name: match_top_over_candidates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bo.match_id AS match_id,
  bo.innings AS innings_id,
  bo.over_number AS over_number,
  bo.runs_in_over AS over_total_runs,
  bo.bowler_id AS bowler,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY bo.match_id
    ORDER BY bo.runs_in_over DESC, bo.over_number ASC
  ) AS over_rank_within_match
FROM over_runs AS bo
views.description: Within each match, rank or order overs by over_total_runs descending and then by over_number ascending to deterministically break ties. Keep candidate rows with their rank/row_number so a single top over per match can be chosen.

views.name: match_top_over_and_average
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mto.match_id AS match_id,
  mto.over_number AS over_number,
  mto.over_total_runs AS highest_over_total_runs,
  mto.bowler AS bowler,
  (SELECT AVG(match_max_runs_in_over) FROM match_max_over_runs) AS average_of_highest_over_totals
FROM match_top_over_candidates mto
WHERE mto.over_rank_within_match = 1
views.description: From the ranked candidates, select the single top over per match (rank = 1) and produce one row per match with match_id, chosen over_number, over_total_runs, and bowler. Also compute the overall average of these per-match highest over_total_runs (as a scalar) — the final result relation should include per-match rows plus the single aggregate value returned separately.

views.name: season_match_player_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.season_id AS season_id,
  bb.match_id AS match_id,
  -- construct a delivery_id as combination to be unique per delivery: match|over|ball|innings
  (bb.match_id || '-' || bb.innings_no || '-' || bb.over_id || '-' || bb.ball_id) AS delivery_id,
  bb.striker AS batsman_player_id,
  bb.bowler AS bowler_player_id,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS batsman_runs,
  wt.kind_out AS dismissal_type,
  wt.player_out AS dismissed_player_id
FROM ball_by_ball bb
JOIN "match" m ON m.match_id = bb.match_id
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
  ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id
  AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id
  AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
views.description: Select the ball-by-ball batting and dismissal events for each delivery, annotated with season and player roles. Each row represents one delivery event and includes runs scored by the striker (batsman), the bowler who delivered, any dismissal type and dismissed player id if present, and the season identifier for that match.

views.name: batsman_season_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.season_id AS season_id,
  b.striker AS batsman_player_id,
  SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS batsman_total_runs
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN "match" m
  ON b.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY
  m.season_id,
  b.striker
views.description: Aggregate total runs per batsman within each season by summing runs scored on deliveries from the event-level relation.

views.name: bowler_season_wickets
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.season_id AS season_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_player_id,
  COUNT(*) AS bowler_total_wickets
FROM wicket_taken w
JOIN match m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN ball_by_ball b ON b.match_id = w.match_id
  AND b.over_id = w.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
WHERE LOWER(w.kind_out) NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
GROUP BY
  m.season_id,
  b.bowler
views.description: Count dismissals credited to each bowler within each season, excluding dismissals whose types are 'run out', 'hit wicket', or 'retired hurt'. Each dismissal is attributed to the bowler of the delivery that produced the dismissal.

views.name: season_top3_batsmen_and_bowlers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bsr.season_id,
  bsr_rank.batsman_rank,
  bsr_rank.batsman_player_id,
  bsr_rank.batsman_total_runs,
  bsw_rank.bowler_rank,
  bsw_rank.bowler_player_id,
  bsw_rank.bowler_total_wickets
FROM
  -- base aggregated season batsmen totals
  batsman_season_runs bsr
  -- rank top 3 batsmen per season
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      season_id,
      batsman_player_id,
      batsman_total_runs,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY batsman_total_runs DESC, batsman_player_id ASC) AS batsman_rank
    FROM batsman_season_runs
  ) bsr_rank
    ON bsr.season_id = bsr_rank.season_id
    AND bsr.batsman_player_id = bsr_rank.batsman_player_id
  -- base aggregated season bowlers totals (aliased)
  JOIN bowler_season_wickets bsw
    ON bsw.season_id = bsr.season_id
  -- rank top 3 bowlers per season
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      season_id,
      bowler_player_id,
      bowler_total_wickets,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY bowler_total_wickets DESC, bowler_player_id ASC) AS bowler_rank
    FROM bowler_season_wickets
  ) bsw_rank
    ON bsw.season_id = bsw_rank.season_id
    AND bsw.bowler_player_id = bsw_rank.bowler_player_id
WHERE
  bsr_rank.batsman_rank <= 3
  AND bsw_rank.bowler_rank <= 3
  AND bsr.season_id = bsw.season_id
  AND bsr.batsman_player_id = bsr_rank.batsman_player_id
  AND bsw.bowler_player_id = bsw_rank.bowler_player_id
  -- pair rank i batsman with rank i bowler by joining on rank value
  AND bsr_rank.batsman_rank = bsw_rank.bowler_rank
views.description: Within each season, rank batsmen by total runs (descending) and bowlers by total wickets (descending), break ties by smaller player id, and select the top three of each. Produce rows pairing rank i batsman with rank i bowler for i=1..3, including their ranks and totals alongside the season.

views.name: partnership_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  -- partnership identifier: use innings_no, team_batting, min/max of striker/non_striker plus a running tie-breaker by over/ball to keep deterministic
  (b.innings_no || '-' || b.team_batting || '-' || printf('%03d', b.over_id) || '-' || printf('%03d', b.ball_id)) AS partnership_id,
  -- players involved: striker and non_striker at that ball
  b.striker AS player_a_id,
  b.non_striker AS player_b_id,
  -- player's contributions on that delivery (runs off bat). join to batsman_scored to get runs_scored for that ball for the striker and non-striker (non-striker normally 0)
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS player_a_score,
  0 AS player_b_score
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
views.description: All partnership contribution records: one row per partnership instance within a match that records the two players involved and each player's individual contribution to that partnership. (Do not aggregate across matches.)

views.name: normalized_partner_order
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.partnership_id,
  p.match_id,
  CASE
    WHEN p.player_a_score > p.player_b_score THEN p.player_a_id
    WHEN p.player_a_score < p.player_b_score THEN p.player_b_id
    WHEN p.player_a_score = p.player_b_score AND p.player_a_id > p.player_b_id THEN p.player_a_id
    ELSE p.player_b_id
  END AS player1_id,
  CASE
    WHEN p.player_a_score > p.player_b_score THEN p.player_a_score
    WHEN p.player_a_score < p.player_b_score THEN p.player_b_score
    WHEN p.player_a_score = p.player_b_score AND p.player_a_id > p.player_b_id THEN p.player_a_score
    ELSE p.player_b_score
  END AS player1_score,
  CASE
    WHEN p.player_a_score > p.player_b_score THEN p.player_b_id
    WHEN p.player_a_score < p.player_b_score THEN p.player_a_id
    WHEN p.player_a_score = p.player_b_score AND p.player_a_id > p.player_b_id THEN p.player_b_id
    ELSE p.player_a_id
  END AS player2_id,
  CASE
    WHEN p.player_a_score > p.player_b_score THEN p.player_b_score
    WHEN p.player_a_score < p.player_b_score THEN p.player_a_score
    WHEN p.player_a_score = p.player_b_score AND p.player_a_id > p.player_b_id THEN p.player_b_score
    ELSE p.player_a_score
  END AS player2_score
FROM partnership_events p
views.description: Normalize ordering of the two players within each partnership so we can enforce final ordering rules later: produce player1/player2 such that player1_score >= player2_score; if scores equal, player1_id > player2_id. Keep original scores paired with the chosen player positions.

views.name: partnership_totals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.match_id,
  n.partnership_id,
  n.player1_id,
  n.player1_score,
  n.player2_id,
  n.player2_score,
  (n.player1_score + n.player2_score) AS partnership_total
FROM normalized_partner_order n
views.description: Compute the partnership total (sum of the two normalized player scores) for each partnership row. One row per partnership (already normalized).

views.name: match_max_partnerships
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.partnership_id AS partnership_id,
  p.match_id AS match_id,
  n.player1_id AS player1_id,
  n.player1_score AS player1_score,
  n.player2_id AS player2_id,
  n.player2_score AS player2_score,
  t.partnership_total AS partnership_total
FROM partnership_totals t
JOIN normalized_partner_order n
  ON t.match_id = n.match_id
  AND t.partnership_id = n.partnership_id
JOIN partnership_events p
  ON p.match_id = t.match_id
  AND p.partnership_id = t.partnership_id
JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_total) AS max_total
  FROM partnership_totals
  GROUP BY match_id
) m
  ON t.match_id = m.match_id
  AND t.partnership_total = m.max_total
views.description: For each match, select partnership rows whose partnership_total equals the maximum partnership_total for that match. Preserve one row per tying partnership; results ordered by match_id externally.

views.name: legal_ball_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.innings_no AS innings_id,
  b.over_id AS over_id,
  b.ball_id AS ball_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_off_bat,
  wt.kind_out AS dismissal_type,
  wt.player_out AS dismissal_player_id
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
  ON b.match_id = wt.match_id
  AND b.over_id = wt.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON b.match_id = er.match_id
  AND b.over_id = er.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
WHERE er.extra_type IS NULL OR (er.extra_type NOT IN ('wides','noballs'))
views.description: All individual legal delivery-level events that are not wides or no-balls, with the batter runs scored off the bat, the bowler who delivered, the match and innings identifiers, and the dismissal info for that delivery. Exclude deliveries that are extras (wides/no-balls) so balls and runs count only legal deliveries and runs_off_bat only includes runs scored off the bat.

views.name: bowler_match_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id AS match_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled_off_bat,
  SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded_off_bat,
  COUNT(w.player_out) AS wickets_credited
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
  ON w.match_id = b.match_id
  AND w.over_id = b.over_id
  AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(w.kind_out, '')) NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt')
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.bowler
views.description: Per bowler per match aggregation of legal deliveries: total balls (count of legal balls), total runs conceded off the bat (sum of runs_off_bat), and total wickets in that match credited to the bowler (count of dismissals on those deliveries excluding run-outs and any dismissal types not credited to the bowler).

views.name: bowler_career_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bms.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  SUM(bms.balls_bowled_off_bat) AS total_balls_bowled_off_bat,
  SUM(bms.runs_conceded_off_bat) AS total_runs_conceded_off_bat,
  SUM(bms.wickets_credited) AS total_wickets_credited
FROM
  bowler_match_stats bms
GROUP BY
  bms.bowler_id
HAVING
  SUM(bms.balls_bowled_off_bat) > 0
views.description: Per bowler career-level aggregates computed from legal-ball events or from bowler_match_stats: total balls bowled (legal), total runs conceded off the bat, and total wickets credited (excluding run-outs and non-bowler dismissals). This relation is one row per bowler and is used to compute economy and strike rate and apply the filter that bowlers must have bowled at least one legal delivery.

views.name: bowler_best_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bms.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  bms.best_match_wickets AS best_match_wickets,
  bms.best_match_runs AS best_match_runs
FROM (
  SELECT
    bm.bowler_id,
    bm.match_id,
    bm.wickets_credited AS best_match_wickets,
    bm.runs_conceded_off_bat AS best_match_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY bm.bowler_id
      ORDER BY bm.wickets_credited DESC, bm.runs_conceded_off_bat ASC, bm.match_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM bowler_match_stats AS bm
) AS bms
WHERE bms.rn = 1
views.description: For each bowler, pick the single best match performance formatted later as 'wickets-runs': rank that bowler's matches by wickets_credited (desc) then runs_conceded_off_bat (asc) and select the top-ranked match to produce one row per bowler with that match's wickets and runs.

views.name: per_innings_player_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  le.match_id AS match_id,
  le.innings_id AS innings_id,
  le.dismissal_player_id AS player_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  pm.role AS role,
  p.batting_hand AS batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill AS bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(bie.runs_off_bat_sum,0) AS innings_batter_runs,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legal_ball_events le2
    WHERE le2.match_id = le.match_id
      AND le2.innings_id = le.innings_id
      AND le2.dismissal_player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
      AND le2.dismissal_type IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS innings_dismissals,
  COALESCE(bb.balls_faced,0) AS innings_balls_faced,
  COALESCE(bms.balls_bowled_off_bat,0) AS innings_balls_bowled,
  COALESCE(bms.wickets_credited,0) AS innings_wickets,
  COALESCE(bms.runs_conceded_off_bat,0) AS innings_runs_conceded
FROM
  -- base legal ball events to enumerate player-innings where player batted or was dismissed
  legal_ball_events le
LEFT JOIN
  -- aggregate runs off bat per player-innings (uses batting_innings_events-like semantics)
  (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      inning_id AS innings_id,
      player_id,
      SUM(runs_off_bat) AS runs_off_bat_sum
    FROM batting_innings_events
    GROUP BY match_id, inning_id, player_id
  ) bie
  ON bie.match_id = le.match_id
  AND bie.innings_id = le.innings_id
  AND bie.player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
LEFT JOIN
  -- balls faced per player in an innings computed from legal_ball_events (count of deliveries to that batsman)
  (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      innings_id,
      dismissal_player_id AS player_id,
      COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM legal_ball_events
    WHERE dismissal_player_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_id, dismissal_player_id
  ) bb
  ON bb.match_id = le.match_id
  AND bb.innings_id = le.innings_id
  AND bb.player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
LEFT JOIN
  -- bowler match stats aggregated per match and bowler; join by treating bowler as player when summarizing bowling for that innings' match
  (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      bowler_id AS player_id,
      SUM(balls_bowled_off_bat) AS balls_bowled_off_bat,
      SUM(runs_conceded_off_bat) AS runs_conceded_off_bat,
      SUM(wickets_credited) AS wickets_credited
    FROM bowler_match_stats
    GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id
  ) bms
  ON bms.match_id = le.match_id
  AND bms.player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
LEFT JOIN player p
  ON p.player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
LEFT JOIN player_match pm
  ON pm.match_id = le.match_id
  AND pm.player_id = le.dismissal_player_id
GROUP BY
  le.match_id,
  le.innings_id,
  le.dismissal_player_id,
  p.player_name,
  pm.role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  bie.runs_off_bat_sum,
  bb.balls_faced,
  bms.balls_bowled_off_bat,
  bms.wickets_credited,
  bms.runs_conceded_off_bat
views.description: Aggregate cleaned events to produce one row per player-innings: sum of batter_runs_excluding_extras in that innings, max of any single-innings score entries if raw events might be split, count of dismissals in that innings (0/1), sum balls_faced, sum balls_bowled, sum wickets taken in that innings, sum runs_conceded_nonextra. Also carry player attributes and the match id. This preserves multiple innings in same match as separate rows.

views.name: career_player_summary_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_batter_runs),0) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_dismissals),0) AS total_dismissals,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_balls_faced),0) AS total_balls_faced,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_balls_bowled),0) AS total_balls_bowled,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_wickets),0) AS total_wickets,
  COALESCE(SUM(pi.innings_runs_conceded),0) AS total_runs_conceded,
  COALESCE(MAX(pi.innings_batter_runs),0) AS highest_score,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pi.innings_batter_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS innings_30_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pi.innings_batter_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS innings_50_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pi.innings_batter_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS innings_100_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pi.match_id),0) AS distinct_matches_count,
  -- match_level_role_counts: JSON-like aggregation of role counts per match (match_id:role -> count 1 per match)
  -- Represented as a text blob: concatenated "match_id|role" rows separated by ';' to keep single-row per player
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mr.role || ':' || mr.cnt, ';')
     FROM (
       SELECT pi2.match_id, pi2.role, 1 AS cnt
       FROM per_innings_player_aggregates pi2
       WHERE pi2.player_id = p.player_id
       GROUP BY pi2.match_id, pi2.role
     ) mr
    ), ''
  ) AS match_level_role_counts,
  -- match_level_threshold_flags: per-match flags indicating if any innings in that match met thresholds (30/50/100) encoded as "match_id:30|50|100" where each is 0/1
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mf.match_id || ':' || mf.f30 || '|' || mf.f50 || '|' || mf.f100, ';')
     FROM (
       SELECT
         pi3.match_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pi3.innings_batter_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f30,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pi3.innings_batter_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f50,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pi3.innings_batter_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f100
       FROM per_innings_player_aggregates pi3
       WHERE pi3.player_id = p.player_id
       GROUP BY pi3.match_id
     ) mf
    ), ''
  ) AS match_level_threshold_flags
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN per_innings_player_aggregates pi
  ON pi.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill
views.description: Combine per-innings aggregates into one-row-per-player career-level measures and per-match summary helpers: totals across all innings (total_runs, total_dismissals, total_balls_faced, balls_bowled, total_wickets, total_runs_conceded), distinct matches played, per-player highest single-innings score, counts of innings meeting 30/50/100 thresholds, and a per-match threshold indicator (one row per match per player) to allow counting matches where any innings in that match meets thresholds. Also compute role frequency per match for later most_frequent_role determination (keeps match-level role occurrences).
